title: Bug: device-testing policy calls decided D-QA-016 open
body:
T39 #686, PL-03 / L-03. **Severity: Medium.** Confirmed by the accepted A–C audit; filing at Stage D does not claim a fix.

## Trace

`docs/device-testing-policy.md:5` labels D-QA-016 open. The accepted trace records D-QA-016 decided on 2026-09-13, D-QA-027 on 2026-09-17 and #131 closed on 2026-09-20. The policy was edited on 2026-10-15 without updating this sentence. A tester following the policy treats a settled dedicated-device decision as unresolved.

Evidence: [accepted finding verification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/c61bcdcb5f2de47dfa35ac25776965e77f962914/docs/audits/2026_11_01-epic-m6-doctrine-reference/04-analysis.md#l-03-docsdevice-testing-policymd5); [forward audit and retained receipts](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/c61bcdcb5f2de47dfa35ac25776965e77f962914/docs/audits/2026_11_01-epic-m6-doctrine-reference/02-forward-audit.md). Reviewed source: `86ebb6dffc`. [Stage-C acceptance](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/issues/686#issuecomment-6582545265).

**Already written:** The misleading status is in the policy that AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and the relevant rule files direct testers to read.

**Can this be done on the VM?** No -- the tree, the tool or the register shows it.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The committed policy cites the settled register rows and no longer calls D-QA-016 open. The receipt includes the corrected sentence, the decided rows and the L-03 check output; existing per-action permission requirements remain intact.

## Ownership

Policy text only under ruling (l). The corresponding vm-first.md rule sentence belongs to the coordinator. Execution waits for the coordinator's `docs/reviews/briefs/t39-streams.md`. This reactive bug has no milestone or parent; the audit punch list will link it.

Stage-D filing identity: Codex / GPT-6-Astra / xhigh; session 01a19d12-0c07-7ba3-88b8-ab9d609f4d67; Herdr T1 wN:p4.
No A–C test was repeated for this filing.
